original artifact URL and SHA-256 captured from downloaded bytes
Bangla source text manually checked against page image; OCR compared but not treated as authoritative

commencement clause, retrospective effect, savings, transition and repeal clauses

interval_method.date_convention: from inclusive; to_exclusive exclusive; null end means not yet established as ended, not proof of continuing force.
steps: Identify exact proposition and exact provision/subsection/paragraph/schedule for the rule.
Establish parent instrument commencement from its own commencement clause and Gazette.
Enumerate every amendment, substitution, repeal, delegated rule, SRO, regulator instrument, corrigendum and binding judicial order affecting that exact provision or proposition.
For each instrument, separately record assent/publication date and legal effective date; do not equate them unless the commencement clause says so.
Apply retrospective clauses only to their stated scope and subject to constitutional/statutory validity and savings/transitional clauses.
Split intervals at each legally operative change; preserve old/new wording and affected event-date logic.
Have independent Bangladesh counsel approve the provision mapping, source chain, scope and interval; hash the reviewed payload.
prohibited_inferences: current consolidated text proves historical wording on a past date
a section number alone proves the candidate rule is within that section
a regulator guideline is binding legislation without an enabling/legal-effect analysis
a current amendment changes every rule that cites the parent Act
